quote: I am an environment artist creating high and low poly assets for several projects including the game Wayward Realms. After fighting several other apps and spending too much money SculptForge fits like a hand-made glove. While there is much to love about this software I am glad I found something that actually makes sense.
name: Richard Throgmorton (MakIt3D)

quote: After years of struggling with expensive software subscriptions, finding SculptForge felt like a breath of fresh air. It is evolving fast, with new improvements arriving regularly, and I genuinely believe it has a bright future. What excites me most is how it is made: artists steering and agents building is a monumental change in how software gets developed. My advice as a Senior Lead Character & Creature Artist and mentor: don't chase millions of polygons. Plan your models, build your forms intelligently, and add detail when needed. I strongly recommend every artist give it a try.
name: Abhik Mitra (VOIDART ACADEMY)

quote: I'm primarily focused on digital sculpting and using SculptForge for my workflow as a multimedia freelancer. I was really happy to find software that lets me get into my creative flow. And boy does it handle the polygon counts.
name: Hameron

quote: I've had a long-standing interest in sculpting various human faces. My goal is to block out the primary forms in Blender, send the base mesh or Shape Keys to SculptForge to sculpt fine forms and surface textures, and then complete the piece.
name: Hong's Art Lab (hmh426)
context: Blender to SculptForge for fine detail

quote: Any open source program is a win in my book. So when I saw this and the membership for a reasonable price to support, I jumped on it. I really want to see a program that is not driven by subscriptions with very little return year after year.
name: Artizmo

quote: I'm a product designer by education, but I've been 3D modelling for more than a decade and sculpting for about 5 years now. I mostly sculpt characters and assets for my own game projects.
name: Can Ugur

quote: I'm really happy to be part of the SculptForge community. I'm genuinely impressed by what the team is building, and I really appreciate the effort and dedication that goes into developing such a powerful sculpting application. I have high hopes for SculptForge, and I'm excited to see how it continues to grow and evolve!
name: A SculptForge member

quote: I mainly create characters, creatures, and various 3D models. I'm particularly interested in its sculpting capabilities, Quad Remesh, and integration with AI tools. Features such as face extrusion, inset, bevel, edge loops, and bridge operations would make SculptForge even more powerful.
name: TETSUYA

quote: I like how powerful SculptForge is already.
name: Rand_gogh

quote: I work in the film industry during the day and at night I'm designing robots using a variety of digital design tools, then 3d printing and mechanizing them for my businesses. I also produce a lot of personal creatures and organic designs for 3D printing.
name: fxrtst
